Hello! I’m a multidisciplinary artist who uses technology as a means of expression. For the past 12 years, I’ve been working as a music producer and DJ, where I realized that music was just one of the ways I could create. My journey with visual arts started back in 2011, when I used to edit videos for videogames, which first introduced me to After Effects. Years later, as I revisited and deepened my studies, I discovered Motion Design and understood that it was the field that truly connected everything I had learned so far, from music to programming, editing videos and 3D.

Over the years, I’ve had the opportunity to collaborate with freelance designers on personal portfolio projects for artists such as Kontronatura, Cortes Brabos, Juliana Ziebel, and Mariana Valente. I’ve also worked with independent brands like Ovni, Kenner, RA.bisco, and Outermost Records, creating videos for online platforms, product releases, and engaging in the entire creative process, from soundtrack production to video editing. Alongside this, I’ve continued my career as a music producer, releasing tracks on several record labels around the world.

Most recently, I worked as a freelance Motion Designer for Tátil Design, where I developed a complete brand guide, creating assets, look & feel, a full Motion guideline for internal use, and an animated UI/UX showcase in both After Effects and Figma in collaboration with a whole design team.
